blocks.text: The 25 EUR M packaging spend includes 1.1 EUR M of rush freight invoiced by the incumbent; a unit-price reduction does not apply to it.
Packaging spend excluding rush freight: 23.9 EUR M.
Unrelated: the energy contract for the Zaragoza plant was renewed in September.
Packaging spend was 25 EUR M in 2025, with the volume split between the incumbent (70%) and Supplier B (30%).
Supplier B offers a 12% price reduction if it receives 100% of our volume under a three-year commitment. This saves 3.0 EUR M per year.
Supplier B volume breaks (price reduction by share of our volume):
We recommend approving the move to a single supplier from January 2026.
Supplier B operates a single plant. It declared two force-majeure stoppages in the last three years, of 9 and 14 days.
A 9-day packaging stoppage would cost us 1.6 EUR M of gross margin; a 14-day stoppage 2.4 EUR M.
The incumbent operates two plants and can cover up to 60% of our volume at two weeks' notice.
If kept at 30% of our volume, the incumbent has offered a 4% price reduction on that volume.
Switching costs (tooling and line qualification): 0.8 EUR M one-off for a full move, 0.5 EUR M for a partial move.
